title: Divine Principle
author: sun-myung-moon
attributionNote: The Divine Principle is the central doctrinal text of the Unification movement, attributed to Sun Myung Moon and developed with early followers. Its editions and official status vary across Unification bodies.
description: A systematic exposition of Unification theology, including the principle of creation, the fall, restoration and the role of the True Parents. It is a modern movement text, not a historical canon.
historicalContext: First published in Korean in 1966 and subsequently translated and revised. The Unification movement has split into multiple organisations with different authority claims.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Modern translations are copyrighted. No text is imported.
